//: FRAGMENT fixture for the KPI SUPPORTING TILE sub-component — the `.pa-kpi-hero-side` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.KpiHero.kpi_hero_side/1`, svelte `display/KpiHeroSide.svelte`). This is one compact tile in the right-side rail of a `.pa-kpi-hero-list` (the container is covered by kpi-hero.json, which defers this block to THIS fixture via a fixture-ref). `.pa-kpi-hero-side` is a standalone block (hyphen-joined, NOT a `pa-kpi-hero-list__*` element) carrying its own sentiment modifiers (--positive/--negative/--neutral/--up-strong, which only re-point the `--pa-kpi-accent` cascade on __delta). It is a 2×2 grid: __label top-left, __delta bottom-left, __value (wrapping __num + optional __unit/prefix) spanning both rows on the right. GOTCHA: both wrappers ALWAYS emit the __label and __value cells (even when empty), because the grid areas are fixed; only __delta is conditional. SCOPE = the full text/structural shape both wrappers agree on. The detail popover (`.pa-kpi-detail`, shared by every KPI tile) is opt-in (renders only when a detail title/slot is set) and is a SEPARATE block covered by kpi-detail.json, so no scenario enables it. Authored from snippets/kpi.html L506-515 + _kpi-hero-supporting.scss.

propsVocabulary.variant: sentiment accent — pa-kpi-hero-side--{variant}; only re-points the --pa-kpi-accent cascade (delta colour). Default (nil) emits NO modifier. svelte variant ('positive'|'negative'|'neutral'|'up-strong'); keen variant ('positive'|'negative'|'neutral'|'up-strong', dasherized from its underscored attr value — the dashed value passes through unchanged).
propsVocabulary.label: uppercase mono caption — pa-kpi-hero-side__label; the cell ALWAYS renders (fixed grid area), empty when unset. svelte labelText; keen label_text.
propsVocabulary.value: focal numeric value — rendered as pa-kpi-hero-side__num inside the always-rendered pa-kpi-hero-side__value wrapper. svelte valueText; keen value_text.
propsVocabulary.prefix: currency/scale prefix rendered BEFORE the number as a pa-kpi-hero-side__unit span. svelte prefix; keen prefix_text.
propsVocabulary.unit: unit suffix rendered AFTER the number as a pa-kpi-hero-side__unit span. svelte unit; keen unit_text.
propsVocabulary.delta: Δ text — pa-kpi-hero-side__delta; renders only when set. svelte deltaText; keen delta_text.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the tile (svelte class, keen class) — class passthrough, not a core feature.

goldenConventions: The __label and __value cells ALWAYS render (both wrappers unconditionally emit them so the 2×2 grid areas are present), so EVERY golden carries them — __label is empty when no label is set. Inside __value the prefix __unit span comes first, then the __num, then the suffix __unit span. The __delta cell renders only when the delta text is set. Default variant emits NO modifier class (SCSS treats the bare .pa-kpi-hero-side as the base). The opt-in detail popover is out of scope (never enabled). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

deferred.//: Only the opt-in detail popover is out of scope here — it is the separate `.pa-kpi-detail` block (kpi-detail.json), rendered only when a detail title/slot is set, so no scenario enables it. All of pa-kpi-hero-side's own element classes (__label/__value/__num/__unit/__delta) are exercised by the goldens; nothing from this block is deferred.

features.//: Feature->class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-kpi-hero-side(--|__)'). Block modifiers in CSS: --positive/--negative/--neutral/--up-strong (all produced by the `variant` enum). Element classes in CSS: __label, __value, __num, __unit, __delta — all claimed by a feature's produces + exercised by a golden. produces:null = structural/native (no pa-kpi-hero-side modifier).
